description: The served quickstart (docs/quickstart.md line 35), the console Agents panel ('open it and click Approve') and the home page ('shows a pairing code') never mention the verification code that the approval page blocks on. Only llms.txt and connect-an-agent.md do.
expected: Every surface that describes approval says 'type the verification code'.
actual: Three surfaces omit it; the page then requires the code.
suggested_fix: Add 'and type the verification code the agent printed' to those three texts.

description: The signed-out sign-in page gives no indication that an agent approval is waiting or that the link will return the user to it, and the 10-minute code lifetime is not mentioned.
expected: A short note such as 'Sign in to approve your agent' (not verifiable with real Clerk here).
suggested_fix: Show context text when redirect_url is /connect.

description: With Details open the Approve agent button sits below the 800 px fold, so a user who opens Details must scroll to find the primary action.
expected: Primary action visible or Details content compact.
actual: Approve button cut at bottom edge in step-4 (y>=795).
suggested_fix: Make Details two-column or collapse the delegate hint.
